mainEntity.name: How much does a kitchen bump-out or kitchen addition typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a kitchen addition depends on the added square footage, foundation requirements, plumbing relocation, and finish materials. Ground-up structural additions involve excavation, framing, roofing, and tie-ins to existing electrical and plumbing systems, making them a larger investment than interior updates. Custom cabinetry, stone countertops, appliance packages, and exterior finishes like matching stucco also shape overall pricing. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms reviews specific goals during on-site estimates, provides free quotes, and offers negotiable pricing and veteran discounts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on added square footage, foundation needs, utility tie-ins, and finishes like cabinetry and countertops. Free quotes and negotiable pricing help establish the budget.
